padding-tp.d: Growing a dimension to the next convenient multiple (\( n' = \lceil n/L \rceil L \)) so that the TP degree divides it, filling the excess with inert values (zeros; −∞ where there is a softmax).

bmm.d: Several independent matrix multiplications executed in a single kernel call, one per batch item (here, one per output group). The kernel requires all of their shapes to match exactly.

instanciacao-kernel.d: Templated CUDA kernels are only compiled for certain parameter combinations (e.g., 8, 16, 32, 64 or 128 local heads). A shape outside the table has no code; the way out is to pad inside the call or switch kernels.

trellis-exl3.d: ExLlamaV3's quantization format, in which weights are encoded in 16 × 16 tiles of a procedural trellis. Tiles that are already packed can't be cropped or padded without repacking.

plano-de-controle.d: The coordination TCP traffic of a distributed job (rendezvous, TCPStore, Gloo, NCCL bootstrap), kept separate from the RDMA data plane. It needs one interface that reaches every rank.

subnet-aware-routing.d: A mode in which NCCL pairs ports by the IP subnet of the GID rather than by NIC index (NCCL_IB_SUBNET_AWARE_ROUTING, with NCCL_IB_SUBNET_PREFIX_LEN). Required in the 3-node ring; not listed on the public variables page for NCCL 2.32.3.

anel-dirigido.d: Cabling for 3+ nodes with two ports each, in which every node's Port0 goes to the next node's Port1, giving the same out/in rule on all of them. A mirrored ring leaves one pair that never connects.

stall-distribuido.d: A hang in which one rank stops making progress (in a kernel, for example) and all the others get stuck waiting at the next collective, until a timeout brings the engine down.

race-condition.d: A defect in which the result or the progress depends on the timing of concurrent accesses to shared state. It is rare, load-dependent and hard to reproduce.

fatiamento-chamada.d: Running one large kernel call as several smaller calls over slices of the batch (e.g., ≤ 64 query rows). It changes the execution regime without changing the math; used as a stall mitigation on TP4.

faulthandler.d: A module that, when enabled with PYTHONFAULTHANDLER=1, dumps the Python traceback of every thread when the process receives a fatal signal (SIGSEGV, SIGABRT, SIGFPE, SIGBUS, SIGILL).

soak.d: A long load test, from tens of minutes to hours, with a realistic mix of requests, designed to find rare failures (hangs, leaks, OOM) that a short benchmark misses. E.g., the 150-min soak that hung GLM's TP=4 3 out of 3 times.

lane-servico.d: A complete, alternative way of serving the model within a recipe, with its own launcher, variable profile, patches and topology (e.g., the 2-node lane and the TP=3 lane). Switching lanes means swapping the whole set, not a single knob.

anel-sem-switch.d: Four or more nodes cabled in a loop, each node's two ports going to its two neighbours, with no switch. Nodes across from each other share no cable and talk through a relayed hop, so rank placement and the collective algorithm must follow the cabling (e.g., the 0-1-3-2 order in TensorFold, the sparkring NCCL in SGLang).

salto-retransmitido.d: A path between two nodes with no direct cable that goes through a neighbour: the message reaches the neighbour, which forwards it (in software, or in hardware on the NIC). It costs at least one extra latency α and shares the neighbour's cable with its own traffic.

split-2d.d: How TensorFold's engine splits DeepSeek-V4.1 over four Sparks: each Spark is a node \(g = 2p + r\) of a grid, with two TP2 pairs (\(p\)) of two ranks (\(r\)). The heavy exchanges are with the row partner \(g \oplus 1\) and the column partner \(g \oplus 2\), never with \(g \oplus 3\).

rail-optimized.d: A cluster layout in which GPU \(k\) of every node goes through NIC \(k\) to the same leaf switch (rail \(k\)). Same-numbered GPUs on different nodes are one hop apart; everything else climbs to the spine. Frameworks and NCCL place ranks and routes to take advantage of it.

divisao-desigual.d: Cutting a dimension into whole units as evenly as possible, with the remainder on the lowest ranks (64 heads over 3 ranks: 22/21/21), instead of padding it to a multiple of \(p\). Only possible when the communication moves whole tensors (an all-gather of full-width partials, an all-to-all with per-rank counts).
